article.title: Managing Recurring Donations on Mightycause
article.body:
Recurring Donations on Mightycause

Organizations have the ability to manage recurring or monthly donations right on Mightycause.

To review all of your recurring donations on Mightycause, head over to your organization profile page and on the left-hand side dashboard select "Reports" > "Recurring Donations"

  

Any recurring donations that have been set up for your organization, will be listed here.

At the top, you can search for a particular recurring donation by Status (i.e. Active, Canceled), Campaign Type (i.e. View by Fundraiser, Team, Event), or Search by Donor Name. As well at the top you will be able to see how many active recurring donations you have on the platform and how many recurring donations have canceled.

Please note, if you see an exclamation mark icon (!) next to the Active status, that signifies that the recurring donation is active but the credit card on file is about to expire. We recommend directly reaching out to the donor to ensure they update their credit card information.

If you would like review more detailed information on these donations, click the download icon to export this information into an excel sheet.

Cancel a Recurring Donation

Donors can update their recurring donation right on their user account. Please direct donors who wish to update their recurring donation to this support article How to Set Up and Manage Your Recurring Donation on Mightycause. 

An Admin for the nonprofit can also cancel a recurring donation on behalf of a donor by following these steps from the recurring donation dashboard: 

  • Find the recurring donation that needs to be canceled and select the 3 dot menu all the way to the right of this donation. Choose Cancel Recurring Donation
  • The below pop-up will appear. Choose the cancellation reason and then 'confirm.' A notification email will be sent to the donor to confirm the recurring donation was canceled.

If a donor still has questions about managing their recurring donation, please have them reach out to support@mightycause.com
